description: The StartButton_DI block processes a digital input value and generates a quality code based on the input value and other parameters.

inputs.name: VALUE
inputs.description: The digital input value from the process image

inputs.name: VALUE_QC
inputs.description: The value status of the digital input channel

inputs.name: MODE
inputs.description: Influences how the block treats the digital input value

inputs.name: PQC
inputs.description: Determines if the block reads the value status of the digital value from the process image

inputs.name: SIM_I
inputs.description: The simulation value output when SIM_ON is TRUE

inputs.name: SIM_ON
inputs.description: Activates simulation mode, giving SIM_I the highest priority

inputs.name: SUBS_I
inputs.description: The substitute value used when the digital input value is invalid and SUBS_ON is TRUE

inputs.name: SUBS_ON
inputs.description: Enables the use of a substitute value when the digital input is invalid

inputs.name: LAST_ON
inputs.description: Determines if the last valid output value should be held when the current value is invalid

outputs.name: QBAD
outputs.description: Indicates if the output value Q is invalid

outputs.name: QLAST
outputs.description: Indicates if the last valid value injection is active

outputs.name: QSIM
outputs.description: Indicates if simulation mode is active

outputs.name: QSUBS
outputs.description: Indicates if a substitute value is being used

outputs.name: QUALITY
outputs.description: The quality code of the output value Q, indicating its status
